video_title: Isiah Thomas - JEALOUSY Is Why LeBron Not In Top-5's!

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on why former players exclude LeBron James from top-5
quotes.excerpt: Guys are jealous. They get envious. They intentionally ignore the obvious.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: None of them had LeBron James in their top-5. What is the disconnect there between LeBron and these guys?

text_blocks.speaker: Isiah Thomas
text_blocks.text: Jealousy. They get envious. Y'all bring them on the show, then they want to talk about what they did, or what somebody else did, and then they intentionally ignore the obvious. And when you intentionally ignore the obvious, then that has to come back to some jealousy or envy or just straight-up BS. This man got every basketball record on the books, and he ain't in your top-5, you full of shit.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on the unique passion of New York Knicks fans
quotes.excerpt: New York is on steroids because they're so starved. It's a different kind of passion.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: What do you make of these New York Knicks fans?

text_blocks.speaker: Isiah Thomas
text_blocks.text: What we're watching, you got to put them as some of the best. New York is on steroids because they're so starved. It's a different kind of passion that we're seeing. The other fan bases, we do the same tricks. All fans stay at the hotel, pull the hotel alarms, and they didn't throw eggs, they threw coins. But I think what New York has, it has a hunger and a passion that no other basketball city has because it's been starved for so long.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on the Boston Celtics being the toughest road environment
quotes.excerpt: Boston had all the tricks. You walk out on the floor, they're calling you every name.
quotes.quote: Boston Celtics. It ain't no question. We had to bring our own water because we couldn't order room service. They was pulling the alarms. We had to walk outside 4:00 in the morning. We're going to our locker room, the air conditioning was off, it was heated up. The showers were cold. Boston had all the tricks. You walk out on the floor, they're calling you every name, mentioning everything. But it made you want to beat them and it made you so tough.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on the Boston Celtics shutting down the airport
quotes.excerpt: Logan Airport would not let a flight take off after 10:00 if it was the Detroit Pistons.
quotes.quote: When we would try to leave Boston, they would shut the airport down. Logan Airport would not let a flight take off after 10:00 if it was the Detroit Pistons. A lot of times we couldn't get out. Boston had all the tricks and they used them.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on the need for honesty in NBA media coverage
quotes.excerpt: If they're going to be 100% honest and not promote this BS. Tell the truth about the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: How do you feel about the idea of bringing in more legends and having them be more involved on a more daily basis?

text_blocks.speaker: Isiah Thomas
text_blocks.text: Only if they're going to be 100% honest and not promote this BS. Tell the truth about the game, give our game truthfully, honestly, and factually to the fans so they can continue to learn and grow and love our game. But the way our game now is being talked about in some ways, it's very mythical. It ain't real.
